newsitem.title: USA: Greenway may bid for Outboard Marine -filing.
newsitem.headline: Greenway may bid for Outboard Marine -filing.

text.p: Greenway Partners LP and affiliates said in a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing they are considering a bid for Outboard Marine Corp that could top Detroit Diesel Corp's $16-per-share friendly deal announced last month.

The Greenway groups, which together hold about 9.9 percent of Outboard's common stock or two million shares, stated they are "actively exploring the possibility of making an offer to the company and/or its stockholders that would represent a superior transaction" over the Detroit Diesel deal, which in total is worth about $500 million.
Detroit Diesel and Outboard Marine spokepersons were not immediately available to comment.
A telephone message left for Gary Duberstein of Greenway Partners was not immediately returned.
In Monday midafternoon trade, Outboard shares were up 5/16 to 16-5/16, off a session-high 17. The stock's year high is 19-7/8, the year low 10-5/8.
